title: MCP Transports: stdio and Stateless Streamable HTTP

questions.question: Which HTTP method carries every modern Streamable HTTP message?
questions.explanation: Each modern JSON-RPC request or notification is a new POST to one MCP endpoint.

questions.question: What should a modern-only MCP endpoint return for GET and DELETE?
questions.explanation: Standalone GET and DELETE are not part of Streamable HTTP 2026-07-28.

questions.question: Which headers must match the body on every modern request?
questions.explanation: Mcp-Name is also required for tools/call, resources/read, and prompts/get.

questions.question: How does a client request long-lived change notifications?
questions.explanation: subscriptions/listen opens the response stream. Its acknowledgement, notifications, and final result carry the listen request id as subscription metadata.

questions.question: A modern request-scoped SSE stream breaks before its final response. What next?
options: Retry safely with a new JSON-RPC id
questions.explanation: Modern SSE is not resumable. A safe retry is a new request with a new id.

questions.question: What should a server do with Mcp-Session-Id on a 2026-07-28 request?
options: Ignore it and do not echo it
Reject every request that includes it
questions.explanation: Protocol sessions and the session header were removed from the modern revision.
